channel.agc: settled gain from whole-record rms of the noisy signal, target 32.0 LSB rms, 1.5 dB steps
channel.noise: complex white, full 8 MHz band, variance from Eb/N0

receiver.scoring: bit errors are wrong decisions among the bits the receiver returned; a synced packet delivered with the wrong length (length field corrupted, or the demodulation exhausted the record) is counted in undelivered_packets and scored over the comparable prefix only — the un-demodulated remainder is not charged (decision 0009); packet_loss is the fraction of packets not delivered intact (sync miss or wrong-length delivery)
